primary_protomer_rule: lexicographically first canonical isomeric SMILES before docking

three_dimensional_embedding.seed_rule: SHA256 of CHEMBL ID and protomer index mapped to a positive 31-bit integer
three_dimensional_embedding.optimization: MMFF94 when parameters exist, otherwise UFF

anti_bias_rule: Primary protomer is selected before docking; best-scoring protomer selection is prohibited for the primary analysis.
